scope: P00-03 analytic references for P02-02 through P02-08; no device or external qualification

conditions_applied: NC06 analytic and quadrature errors separately recorded
NC06 IDA observation times separated from native BE grid maxima

source_identity_policy: Bind this file digest, implementation digest, inputs, environment and run start before candidate execution. Any gate change requires new independent review and a new affected attempt.

common_rules.zero_inventory: absolute defect on the declared fixed scale; never divide by zero
common_rules.geometry: Explicit control volumes and face measures, applied exactly once by assembly
common_rules.source_reference: Closed-form analytic values or independent 80-digit Decimal evaluation; no production solver as oracle
common_rules.all_steps: Check every published accepted interval and cumulative absolute inventory defect

gates.quantity: physical inventory and two-cell backward Euler state
cases: unequal volumes [1,2] with the same oriented face flux
gates.reference: n1=(M-hL)^-1 M n0; equal-volume n1=[1.25,1.75]; each connected-domain inventory is invariant
gates.counterexample: Ordinary coordinate BDF on n=exp(q) at h=0.5 must be identified as nonconservative; no requirement to accept that route
gates.norm: max over every state component; inventory separately per declared domain
gates.mask: all cells, faces, domains and accepted intervals
gates.inventory_scale: sum(V_i*n_i_initial) within each connected domain; zero domains use fixed inventory scale 1
gates.interval_defect: abs(sum_domain(delta_Q) - integral_of_declared_boundary_flux_and_sources); cumulative is sum of these absolute defects
gates.reference_evaluation: Independent exact rational 2-cell formulas and Decimal80 matrix elimination for BE; Decimal80 exponential for IDA. No production solver is an oracle.
gates.budget_basis: Linear conservation is a discrete identity; 1e-10 retains plan inventory requirement. State budgets are toy arithmetic or independently declared time-accuracy budgets, not IDA solver settings.

gates.reference: r=k*n*(1-f)-e*Nt*f; ndot=-r, Nt*fdot=r. Invariant S=n+Nt*f. BE root f1-f0-h/Nt*r(S-Nt*f1,f1)=0 is unique in the feasible interval.
gates.feasibility: 0 <= f <= 1 and n >= 0, without post-acceptance repair
gates.norm: max absolute/relative component error plus inventory defects for each independently closed case
gates.mask: all species including carrier and occupied traps; all accepted intervals
gates.inventory_scale: S_initial=n_initial+Nt*f_initial for each case; zero case fixed scale 1
gates.interval_defect: abs(delta_n+Nt*delta_f), accumulated as sum of absolute interval defects
gates.reference_evaluation: Decimal80 bisection of the scalar BE equation for 300 iterations on f in [0,min(1,S/Nt)], or exact emission formula. Check state and nonzero rate, not conservation alone.
gates.budget_basis: Invariant is exact by reaction stoichiometry. State/rate references exclude a constant-state implementation.

gates.quantity: consistent physical initial state and tangent
gates.reference: n=exp(q+phi), phi+n=V. Initial n=2,V=0,phi=-2,q=log(2)+2. For V=0.1 preserve n=2, set phi=-1.9,q=log(2)+1.9. For Vdot=s preserve ndot=0, phidot=s,qdot=-s.
negative_cases: holding q fixed changes physical n
incompatible fixed electrode charge and imposed voltage jump
gates.norm: maximum component error, residual infinity norm and tangent infinity norm
gates.mask: all physical state components, algebraic constraints and tangent rows
gates.rank_rule: rank counts singular values > 64*float64_eps*max(matrix.shape)*sigma_max; compare to declared independent row and variable counts
gates.reference_evaluation: Exact n and linear potential/tangent; Decimal80 log(2) for q.
gates.budget_basis: Small analytic equations with unit scale; tolerances exceed binary64 evaluation error without permitting physical population change.

gates.quantity: full nonlinear storage and input Jacobian
gates.reference: Q=exp(2*y+3*a+5*t), R=0, F=Q*(2*ydot+3*adot+5). Fy=2*F, Fa=3*F, Ft=5*F, Fydot=2*Q, Fadot=3*Q. IDA J=Fy+cj*Fydot.
cases: right-end BE Qy-hRy with fixed left state
gates.storage_delta_rule: Use finite Q(right)-Q(left) via stable analytic increments, including input/time changes; never replace by Qy*delta_y
gates.norm: abs(FD-analytic)/max(1,abs(analytic)) for scalar JVP; infinity norm for assembled vectors
gates.mask: every declared derivative, point, cj and direction
gates.direction_normalization: Divide each four-component direction by its Euclidean norm; d_ydot=cj*dy
gates.adjacent_rule: At least two adjacent eps entries must pass for every point/rate/cj/direction. Report all errors; no cherry-picking directions.
gates.reference_evaluation: Decimal80 exponential and analytic derivatives; account for float conversion separately at comparison boundary.
gates.budget_basis: Central-difference truncation plus roundoff should exhibit a plateau; analytic matrix tolerance is independently stricter. Numeric acceptance never replaces exact support coverage.

cases: capacity changes carried in Qa or Qt once
gates.feasibility: theta_i >= 0 and sum(theta_i) <= 1; independent sign constraints alone do not certify this
gates.rank_policy: Record rank loss/conditioning at capacity boundaries; reject an unsupported singular initialization
gates.norm: matrix infinity norm for derivatives; component maximum for storage/delta
gates.mask: all species, cross terms and explicit inactive zero species

zero_case.representation: explicit inactive species; no finite log/softmax coordinate

gates.rank_rule: Use the NC03 relative SVD criterion on the active subspace; explicit zero species are excluded only with zero physical inventory identity
gates.reference_evaluation: Exact C*(diag(theta)-outer(theta,theta)); independent differentiation of that expression for Hessian contractions.
gates.budget_basis: Cross derivatives and storage are analytic local quantities; capacity feasibility is an exact domain check.

gates.quantity: electrode current, charge and RC response
gates.unit: A, C, V, s and S under explicit port area
gates.reference: Pure capacitor Qleft=C*V, Qright=-C*V, Ileft=C*Vdot, Iright=-C*Vdot. RC internal parallel discharge obeys V=V0*exp(-t/(R*C)), I_external=0, Ic=V/R and dQleft/dt=-V/R.
cases: pure algebraic capacitor with no internal storage state
gates.history_rule: IDA derivative is not a one-interval finite difference; use qualified dense output plus independent interval integration
gates.norm: component maximum for state/port/charge, absolute complex error for admittance, interval and cumulative charge separately
gates.mask: both ports, all observation times, every accepted interval and both event limits

rc.be_comparison_times: Every point of each own fixed BE grid from0 to6; no interpolation to the IDA observation_times
rc.be_continuous_error_norm: Maximum absolute error over every point of each own BE grid on [0,6]; compute adjacent ratios from those maxima

gates.reference_evaluation: Decimal80 exponential for continuous RC; exact rational BE recurrence; adaptive independent interval quadrature with absolute target1e-12 and relative target1e-12 on qualified local interpolation.
gates.budget_basis: Continuous IDA trajectory gate and exact discrete BE gate are separate. BE time refinement has independently fixed steps/domain/error; capacitor algebraic/feedthrough gate uses exact identities.
gates.reference_error_scope: reference_error_bound=1e-14 covers analytic evaluation only; independent quadrature error is separately bounded and included in the one-third reference-error budget
gates.quadrature_error_policy: Record the actual quadrature error estimate and an independent tighter-rule/refinement discrepancy. Their conservative combined bound plus analytic error must be <= allowed charge error/3; requested quadrature tolerance is not an accuracy certificate.

gates.quantity: nonlocal sparse support and dense equivalence
gates.reference: R=u*(v^T*y) has Jacobian u*v^T including remote support; a global auxiliary variable gives the same operator after elimination
cases: structural nonzeros with zero current coefficients
sparse versus dense solve on small systems
gates.large_scale_qualification: Separate bounded P02-07 runs must measure 1e4-1e5 unknowns; small equivalence does not certify scale
gates.norm: maximum component residual/state error and full structural edge equality
gates.mask: all rows/columns including global borders and remote derivatives
gates.invertibility: alpha!=0 and alpha!=dot(v,u); check before solve
gates.reference_evaluation: Independent Decimal80 Sherman-Morrison formula and explicit small dense assembly.
gates.budget_basis: Algebraic equivalence and structural support only; large device/2D scale remains a separate gate.

gates.quantity: sub-ULP physical increment and stable driving force
gates.unit: m^-3 for density increment; declared units for other fields
gates.reference: Decimal precision80 independent oracle for n0*expm1(delta_log_n), n0=1e22 and delta_log_n in [0,+1e-17,-1e-17,+1e-16,-1e-16]
gates.zero_rule: strict zero stays zero; weak nonzero remains distinguishable even when rounded absolute state is unchanged
gates.native_r1_qualification: Original source-bound R1 thresholds, ports and low-word identities remain separate and unchanged
gates.norm: Decimal comparison of every increment component and correct strict-zero/nonzero classification
gates.mask: all signs and zero; high and low words; both serialization and restored evaluation
gates.fixed_scale: absolute/relative density increment as declared, not absolute density
gates.reference_evaluation: Construct inputs from exact decimal strings. Decimal80 evaluates n0*sum(x^k/k!,k=1..5); no exp(x)-1 subtraction. Keep the reference decimal until comparing Decimal.from_float(candidate) or both exact binary words.
gates.float_reference_conversion: If a reference is rounded to float64, add 0.5ULP of that reference and the exact decimal-to-binary input quantization contribution; never claim the float reference has error1e-60.
gates.budget_basis: Stable five-term series has a bounded next term for |x|<=1e-16; tolerances resolve the weak increment and cannot be rescaled by1e22 absolute population.

review_history.changes: explicit inputs/norms/masks, stable Decimal series, port signs and conduction charge balance, BE versus IDA RC gates, nonzero trap kinetics, rank witnesses and invertible nonlocal operator
